title: OpenAMRobot embodied AI dataset release
description: One dataset release in datasets/registry.yaml. Describes a released dataset, not an episode. The data lives outside Git at storage_uri; Git holds only this entry with its commits and sha256.

dataset_id.description: Unique, stable identifier of the dataset release.

c9_schema_ref.description: C9 schema the episodes follow, as <owner>/<repository>/<path>@<40 hex commit SHA>.

robot_config.description: Robot configuration name used during capture.

bom_issue.description: Canonical BOM issue number used for the hardware build, for example 7.10. BOM values are not stored here.

episodes.description: Number of episodes in the release.

storage_uri.description: Location of the dataset outside Git.

sha256.description: sha256 of the released dataset archive or manifest, 64 lowercase hex characters.
